correctness.rationale: For every physical Bloch input and non-inverted thermal rate pair, solving the GKSL Bloch ODE yields z_i(q)=-eta+q(z_i+eta) and transverse squared radius q b_i. The exact qubit passive-eigenvalue formula gives e_i(q)=z_i(q)+sqrt(z_i(q)^2+qb_i). Equality at positive work cancels the common eta dependence in e_i(e_i-2z_i(q))=qb_i, giving a unique bath-independent work level. Strict level monotonicity on positive branches, initial and late orderings, and a transverse-root argument give necessary and sufficient reversal with unique t>0. The derivative of the explicit q formula is positive for all thermal biases. Exact rational example and 12000 finite-state tests were executed from the included verifier; these are corroboration, not infinite proof. Zero-work coincident plateaux and bath endpoints were checked and excluded from strict crossing.
